people.name: Caphtor
people.line: Island home of the Philistines; visited by Paul

translations.web: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you,
translations.bsb: The reason I left you in Crete was that you would set in order what was unfinished and appoint elders in every town, as I directed you.
translations.kjv: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:
translations.asv: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that were wanting, and appoint elders in every city, as I gave thee charge;
